Dragon Money is a crypto casino with more than 7,000 slots and six games built by the platform itself. Its live floor comes from five studios, and the cashier charges nothing on crypto payouts.
Before I put any money in, I ran Dragon Money through the 10 checks I apply to every new casino. My test took place in the last week of September 2026 with a newly opened account. I stopped at the payment step, so every finding comes from the live screens. The strip below sums up this Dragon Money review in one row.
All ten checks passed on the first attempt. The cashier and the help desk impressed me most, because both answered my questions before I had to ask.
Here are the ten checks, each with the detail that decided it:
A single failed check would have ended my Dragon Money test early. The cashier and bonus checks took the longest, since those screens hold the most detail.
My first check was the licence, and the casino Dragon Money holds an international one from Curaçao. Every page loads over a TLS connection that protects each sign-in.
Eleven links fill the footer of the Dragon Money official site, from the Agreement to the Partner agreement. The AML and KYC policies matter most before a deposit, since they cover the checks done before payouts. With a Self-Exclusion Policy and a Responsible gaming page in the same row, check one was an easy pass.
Dragon Money registration took my email address and a password. Linking a Google or Telegram profile is the other option on the same form. For later visits, the Dragon Money login needs the password, or an emailed one-time code in its place.
The Security tab supports Google Authenticator and Aegis for a second sign-in step, and I turned it on straight away. A remote sign-out ends sessions on other devices, which helps after using a shared computer.
For check three, I opened the deposit tab on the Dragon Money official website . The crypto side passed on every point I look for:
Phone wallets can scan the code, so there is no need to type the address by hand. Each deposit at Dragon Money is credited to the matching coin wallet, because every currency keeps its own balance. Once a country is chosen in the selector, local bank options appear, each with its fee on the tile.
Check four moved to the Dragon Money withdrawal tab, where every crypto option showed a 0% fee. A single request can take anything from 10 USDT up to 200,000 USDT. Two more rules apply to every payout at the site:
Dragon Money treats the wallet address in the form as confirmed, so I would check it twice. Past requests are listed under the History link of the cashier.
Check five was verification, which Dragon Money runs once, before the first withdrawal. It needs an identity document together with proof of address. Card payouts add a third item, an image of the card where only the first and last digits show. Uploading them on the first day saves a wait at the first cash-out.
Before counting on any bonus, I traced each rule to the screen that states it:
Games count toward a Dragon Money promo code wager at different rates, and Double counts at 0.1x. I set my cashback currency to USDT on TRC20, the option that matched my main wallet. Of all the Dragon Money bonuses, the crypto top-up was the most practical for me, since it carries no wager.
The support page promises round-the-clock help with no days off. Chat and email both show one minute as the average reply time. At the start of my test, the chat window showed agents online and a Start Conversation button.
The FAQ under the contact cards answered most of my questions before I typed them. It covers 21 topics, and the answers about wallets were the most useful for a new player. The email address for support is printed on that page, with the same one-minute average.
Check eight was about taking a break, and I found the Self Exclusion block at the bottom of the settings. The period list is set to 24 hours by default, and one button starts the break immediately. Above that block, two switches turn off the avatars and Division badges of other players.
A warning on the same screen says the break is final once it starts. Access returns by itself when the period ends. A longer break can be arranged through the support chat. The site accepts adults aged 18 and over only. Players who need outside help can contact Gamblers Anonymous for free.
Check nine asked what happens if the main domain stops opening. The answer is a Dragon Money mirror , a second address that opens the same casino and account.
The settings include a switch that sends a notice about each domain change, and I kept it on. The support chat is the safest place to ask for a working Dragon Money mirror link. Links posted on random forums sometimes lead to fake copies of the site.
The last check was mobile play, and Android users get an official app. A homepage banner presents the Dragon Money app as the first place to catch exclusive bonuses.
Owners of an iPhone use the mobile site, and a home-screen shortcut turns it into a one-tap icon. The app and the site share one account, so the balance matches on both. That settled check ten in a few minutes.
Between checks, I tried a few Dragon Money slots in demo mode, which runs on play money. The Demo button appears when the cursor rests on a tile. Four titles from smaller studios made the best first impression:
I left the six Dragon Games for later, since they feel best with real stakes. The Dragon Money live casino listed 311 tables, and three blackjack tables there are named after the site.
Seven things impressed me, and the rules to plan for are few and simple.
For a crypto player, the Dragon Money payout terms alone justify a closer look. The in-house games then add variety that a studio-only casino cannot match.
Three rules are worth planning around before a first deposit.
Setting the cashback currency on the first day settles the first rule for good. The browser version on an iPhone covers the full lobby, so the third rule hardly matters.
Dragon Money passed every check on my list. The cashier and the help desk stood out most.
Crypto payouts carry no fee there, and the currency rules are clear from the first screen. For players who hold crypto and want games built by the platform itself, I recommend the site without hesitation. Turning on two-factor sign-in and picking a cashback currency early make the start even smoother.
Pick the coin you want to cash out in, because payouts return in the deposit currency. I chose USDT on TRC20, which also matched the currency I picked for cashback.
Dragon Money never moves funds between wallets on its own. To keep playing, pick another wallet with a click on the balance or top up the current one.
Yes, the View in currency option in the Wallet section shows crypto amounts as approximate fiat values. No real conversion takes place, and bets are still charged in the original coin.
A bonus game at Dragon Money belongs to the currency used for the purchase. To use it, open the same slot again from that wallet.
Top up the monthly amount again before the month ends, since every Division is counted per calendar month. Amber needs $3 in top-ups a month, and Gold at the top needs $100 and lowers payment fees. The Personal Area shows how much is still missing for the next month.
